sql_templates.description: Identify candidate symbols with significant insider or bulk deal activity and technical support over the last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT symbol,
           stage,
           MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
      AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY symbol, stage
), latest_deals AS (
    SELECT symbol,
           MAX(deal_date) AS latest_deal_date
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals
    WHERE deal_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
    GROUP BY symbol
), candidate_symbols AS (
    SELECT i.symbol
    FROM signals.insider_alerts i
    JOIN latest_stage ls ON i.symbol = ls.symbol
    JOIN latest_deals ld ON i.symbol = ld.symbol
    WHERE i.alert_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days'
)
SELECT e.symbol,
       e.close,
       e.change_pct,
       s.trading_signal
FROM market.equity_eod e
JOIN candidate_symbols c ON e.symbol = c.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON e.symbol = s.symbol
WHERE e.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.equity_eod)
LIMIT 50;
